newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAA ADDS FLIGHTS WORLDWIDE, DUE TO TOURISM.
newsitem.headline: SAA ADDS FLIGHTS WORLDWIDE, DUE TO TOURISM.

text.p: South African Airways (SAA) said on Sunday it was adding several new flights to its timetable due to growing tourism to and from the country.

Its new timetable from July will include a new twice weekly flight to Copenhagen, a twice weekly flight to Osaka that starts in April, and additional frequency on the London, New York, Miami, Hong Kong and Australia routes.
But the state-owned airline said in a statement it would stop flying direct to Munich and Duesseldorf, relying instead on better connections with Germany's Lufthansa, a partner airline.
"SAA will now concentrate on using Frankfurt and Zuerich as its major hubs in (mainland) Europe," it said in a statement.
London remains its main foreign destination, with an extra flight now taking its total to 14 a week.
